name: MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI
description: MMMU is a benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal models on massive multi-discipline tasks demanding college-level subject knowledge and deliberate reasoning. It includes 11.5K meticulously collected multimodal questions from college exams, quizzes, and textbooks, covering six core disciplines.
creator: Xiang Yue, Yuansheng Ni, Kai Zhang, Tianyu Zheng, Ruoqi Liu, Ge Zhang, Samuel Stevens, Dongfu Jiang, Weiming Ren, Yuxuan Sun, Cong Wei, Botao Yu, Ruibin Yuan, Renliang Sun, Ming Yin, Boyuan Zheng, Zhenzhu Yang, Yibo Liu, Wenhao Huang, Huan Sun, Yu Su, Wenhu Chen
rai:dataCollection: Data was collected from free online resources, quizzes, textbooks, and other study materials, ensuring adherence to copyright and licensing regulations.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Questions were sourced from college exams, quizzes, and textbooks, ensuring a diverse collection.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Questions were annotated for accuracy, consistency, and adherence to academic rigor, with a secondary review team vetting annotations.
